notes.title: There have been some updates.
notes.content:
Several parts of this game have been updated.

notes.title: 60% discount event
notes.content:
Since last week, a 60% discount event has been held to commemorate the launch of the minimap store.

 It runs until 12:00 pm on the 22nd (PST 22.21.11 7:00pm), and updates have been applied here and there, and a lot of feedback received from review events in BIC 2022 and minimap has been applied.

 - Adjusted the balance of boss battles.
 - Guide text for the early key system tutorial and flying system guide have been added.
 - Increased visibility in stealth mode.
 - A key used for jumping when operating the keyboard has been added as a cancel function.



 Thank you for your interest.

 Thank you.

notes.title: Add New Mode!!
notes.content:
Hello, I'm a developer.

Thank you very much for purchasing my game!

This time, I added a lot of things while moving the game development engine to the latest version.

- Add New Mode

The newly added mode can be played in 'normal mode' at the start of the new game, and the existing mode can be played in 'original mode'.

To briefly explain the new mode, it is a low-level mode.
There are some people who have commented on the slippery operation, so the content that should be removed and fostered is slightly different from the existing mode, and overall, I think you can enjoy it comfortably. But if you're challenging yourself, the original mode is also love...


- Add Controller Analog Input

In the previous version of Game Maker 1.4, there was a bug related to analog input in the controller input, so only the direction key was possible, but in the latest version, the corresponding part was modified, making it convenient to operate with analog sticks.


- Add Language
Chinese (Simplified) / Japanese has been added.



- Other bug fixes


If you have a wrong sentence or serious bug while playing, please email 'diskzzang@naver.com'.
